name: Seattle
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Seattle Department of Construction and Inspections (SDCI)
notes: 2026 Fee Subtitle (SMC Ch. 22.900) effective Jan 1, 2026. Construction permit fees rose 18% YoY; most other fees +6.5%. Base/hourly rate $292. 5% technology fee (22.900A.100). WA State Building Code Council $6.50 on each residential building permit (RCW 19.27.085).

name: Charlotte
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Mecklenburg County Code Enforcement (LUESA) — issues City of Charlotte building/trade permits
notes: Charlotte building/trade permits are issued by Mecklenburg County Code Enforcement under the LUESA Fee Ordinance (revised July 1, 2026; N.C.G.S. 160D-1110). Separate BEMP permits. Like-for-like reroof ≤ $40,000 is permit-exempt under 160D-1110(c)(5). HVAC change-outs use Section II.D.1 TIP (1.5 × $59.70). Renovations under $100,000 use Note a ($79.61/trade plus per-sf of the room). New decks also need City of Charlotte LDIRL zoning/stormwater review (FY2027 city line items not extracted).

name: Austin
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
notes: FY 2025-26 fee schedule effective Oct 1, 2025. Residential fees are mostly square-footage / program-based (not a single valuation table). Line items used here come from City Council FY26 fee exhibit (File 25-1121 / CM Vela Attachment 1). Credit-card portal surcharge 2.35% ($2 min).

name: Denver
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
notes: Valuation-based building/trade fees in ADMIN 138, republished on denvergov.org/DSfees. Plan review is 50% of the permit fee for work over $2,000. Roofing/siding and some mechanical work can qualify as Quick Permits (no plan review).

name: Phoenix
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
notes: PDD Fee Schedule approved Dec 17, 2025, Ordinance G-7465, effective Jan 20, 2026 (Phoenix City Code Ch. 9 App. A.2). Single valuation-based building permit typically covers trades. Plan review: 100% of permit (min $195) for residential ≤$50k when valuation >$5,000.

name: Nashville
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025); Nashville-Davidson metropolitan government
permitDeptName: Department of Codes and Building Safety
notes: 1-2 family residential building permit is $5.00 per $1,000 of valuation (16.28.110 A.1), plus $25 zoning examination and 10% Codes Tech Fee on the valuation fee. Plan-review fee is exempt for one- and two-family dwellings. Separate plumbing (min $75) and gas/mechanical (min $75) permits.

name: Atlanta
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Department of City Planning, Office of Buildings
notes: ATL311 (updated May 20, 2026) states the minimum permit cost is $150 plus a $25 technology fee. Full valuation schedule is in the Code of Ordinances; a complete extractable fee table was not obtained, so amounts above the published minimum are left null. Deck/patio additions and interior alterations are listed as residential permit types.

name: Portland
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
notes: Building and Other Permits Fee Schedule effective July 10, 2026. Separate electrical, mechanical, and plumbing schedules. Oregon adds a 12% state surcharge on building-permit fees. Additional PP&D plan-review / development-services fees exist on the same PDF and are NOT fully extracted here — totals below are the building-permit line plus the 12% surcharge only.

name: Minneapolis
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Community Planning & Economic Development — Minneapolis Development Review
notes: Building permits use the city valuation table + 65% plan review + MN state surcharge of 0.0005 × value (Title 5 Ch. 91; official Smartsheet on the building-fees page, city page last updated Feb 27, 2026). Existing-dwelling HVAC uses the existing-residential mechanical levels ($84.20 / $132.40 / $216.60 + $1 surcharge). Plumbing minimum is $85.20 including $1 surcharge. Electrical is a separate Minnesota DLI permit.

name: Raleigh
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
notes: FY27 Development Fee Guide (July 1, 2026–June 30, 2027). New residential building permit is 0.38% of calculated construction value. Alterations: Level 1 = 28% of building permit; Level 2 = 50%; Level 3 = 75%. Minimum trade permit $124. Alteration plan review 55% of building permit (min $124). Credit-card processing 3.5% (min $2.50) as of July 1, 2026.

name: Chicago
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
notes: 2026 Amended Building Permit Fee Tables effective Jan 6, 2026 (plan-based, min $602). Stand-alone fees are Municipal Code Table 14A-12-1204.2. Group R ≤4 stories: steep-slope (≥2:12) reroof and in-kind furnace/AC appliance replacement are permit-exempt. New decks typically plan-based ($602 min) because Express still excludes new structures.

name: Houston
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
notes: 2026 BCE Permit Fee Schedule (CPI +1.3910% Jan 1, 2026). Admin $33.56; most permits min $91.06. 1-2 family structural fees are Type/sf tables (repairs/alterations = 20% of new-construction fee) plus admin — not a single valuation table. HVAC repairs/alterations = 2% of valuation + $47, then min + admin. Roof covering ≤100 sf is exempt.

name: Los Angeles
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Los Angeles Department of Building and Safety (LADBS)
notes: City of Los Angeles (not LA County). Building permits use LAMC Table 1-A (Ord. 185,587; still the published table). Express permits: P/GI 2026-003. Plan check 90% of Table 1-A when plans are required. HVAC uses posted Fee Sch. 3 (7/2017). City DSCS 3% + Systems 6%; state SMIP 0.013% and CBSC $1/$25,000 on building permits. LAMC 91.107.1.1 CPI may be applied in the live calculator; published table dollars are used here.

name: Dallas
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: Planning and Development — Building Inspection (Development Services)
notes: Permit Fee Schedule effective July 1, 2025. SF/duplex master alterations use Table B-II ($181/dwelling unit + $100 additional trade) plus $15 technology. Standalone trades use Table B-I (value × 0.009652 × 1.33, min $175) plus $125 inspection per trade + $15 tech. Reroof ≤2 squares is exempt. No Texas state building-permit surcharge.

name: Miami
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
notes: City of Miami (folio prefix 01), not Miami-Dade RER. Exhibit C (Resolution R-26-0200, Apr 23, 2026): residential ≤3 units = 0.50% of construction cost, min $110, plus $40 application. Roofing is exempt from city solid-waste surcharge. City collects F.S. 553.721 (1%) and 468.631 (1.5%) and Miami-Dade §8-12(e) $0.60/$1,000. SAVE 50% city-fee cut for qualifying storm-proof work is not assumed.

name: Boston
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
notes: ISD Building Fees PDF dated May 15, 2023 (still posted 2026-09-01). Short-form $20 + $10 per $1,000 of estimated cost; long-form $50 + $10 per $1,000. Reroof covering-only is short-form. New decks are long-form. Gas/sheet-metal/electrical/plumbing are separate trade permits. No Massachusetts building-permit surcharge on the ISD sheet.

name: Philadelphia
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
notes: PG_012_INF construction fees effective Jan 1, 2025 (still in force 2026-09-01). Oct 1, 2026 PDF is published but not yet effective. 1-2 family roof covering replacement $69; mechanical ductwork incl. appliances $189; new accessory/deck $75 first 500 sf. Every permit: city $3 + PA $4.50 = $7.50. Cabinets/countertops-only are building-permit exempt (non-historic).

name: San Diego
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
notes: City of San Diego, not the county. IB 501 (structures, Aug 2026) and IB 103 (MEP, 2026). Like-for-like reroof with no structure/diaphragm change is permit-exempt (SDMC §129.0203(a)(16); IB 123). HVAC is Simple MEP per-appliance (Table 1B). Decks use IB 501 Table 501C plus General Plan Maintenance $737 when plan review is required. Kitchen/bath no-plan combo is IB 103 Table 3A $440.82.

name: Las Vegas
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
permitDeptName: City of Las Vegas Building and Safety
notes: City of Las Vegas Building and Safety, not unincorporated Clark County. Posted 2020 Building User Fees effective July 1, 2021 remain the published tables. Residential reroof Table 3-E #94 $68+$119 plus $55 issuance. HVAC exact change-out Table 3-D #15 $83+$100 plus $55. Deck Table 3-E #20 $176+$290 plus $55. Kitchen remodel is priced by affected square feet (Table 3-A), not valuation — dollars left null.

name: Washington
populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 city estimates (July 1, 2025)
notes: One jurisdiction (District of Columbia). Alteration/repair: ($30 + 2% of construction value) × 1.10 Enhanced/tech fee (12-M DCMR). Like-kind roofing/coping is permit-exempt outside historic districts and floodplain (12-A105.2). HVAC ≤10 tons typically Instant Mechanical $46 × 1.10 = $50.60. Deck FAQ uses the alteration formula without the green fee.
